why: Issue #706. `dispose` disconnects the observer but leaves an already requested frame queued, so a size change reported just before the HUD is torn down still re-measures and restyles its rows afterwards. Killed by the case that disposes with a frame pending and expects the row width unchanged after the frame runs.
killedBy: menu-row-width.ts: one width per Main Menu row (issue #706) shares one frame between notifications, and cancels a pending frame when disposed
